name: JoAi: Create Social Post

description.en: Create an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn draft. Leave the time empty for a draft, or set a time to schedule it into JoAi's queue (the publish job posts later).
description.de: Erstelle einen Instagram-, X-, Facebook- oder LinkedIn-Entwurf. Ohne Zeit bleibt es ein Entwurf; mit Zeit wird er in JoAis Warteschlange geplant (der Publish-Job postet später).

bot: Use this to draft or schedule an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn post. Upload images with media_upload first when needed, then pass their IDs in order as a JSON array in media. Set scheduledAt in the team timezone when the user names a time - that only queues the post; JoAi's publish job posts to the network later. Omit scheduledAt to keep a draft. Platforms: instagram, x, facebook, linkedin.

inputs.name: Images

description.en: Ordered team media IDs, e.g. ["abc","def"]. Instagram: JPEG 1–10. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Upload with media_upload first.
description.de: Team-Medien-IDs in Reihenfolge, z.B. ["abc","def"]. Instagram: JPEG 1–10. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen.

inputs.bot: JSON array of media IDs from media_upload, in order. Optional for X, Facebook, and LinkedIn text-only posts.

description.en: When JoAi should publish. ISO time. Without a timezone, the team timezone is used. Omit to save a draft. Scheduling queues the post; the publish job posts later.
description.de: Wann JoAi veröffentlichen soll. ISO-Zeit. Ohne Zeitzone gilt die Team-Zeitzone. Weglassen speichert einen Entwurf. Planen reiht ein; der Publish-Job postet später.

description.en: Team slug. Defaults to the current team.

success.en: Social post {{status}}. If scheduled, JoAi will publish when due.
success.de: Social-Post {{status}}. Wenn geplant, veröffentlicht JoAi zum Termin.
